name: Assessment conveyor
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application composition study, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design a shippable assessment operations dashboard called "Ultra13 Agent Benchmark". The job is to track 100 open-source AI agents from intake to scored security assessment, ingest only Ultra13 JSON evidence, show each agent's transparent score out of 100, and reveal aggregate trends. This is composition B: the dominant organizing idea is one continuous horizontal assessment conveyor from Queue through Complete, paired with a dense sortable ledger.
Subject and hierarchy: compact top identity row with exact title "ULTRA13 AGENT BENCHMARK", a primary "UPLOAD ULTRA13 JSON" control, and counters "3 / 100 assessed", "2 blocked", "95 queued"; directly below, a full-width seven-stage workflow strip labeled Queue, Onboard, Discover, Assess, Evidence, QA, Complete with visible work-in-progress counts and literal blocker flags; the main two-thirds area is a tabular agent ledger with fixed columns Index, Agent, Framework, Version, Stage, Evidence, Score, Updated and rows for "openai-agents-python", "google-adk", and "crewai"; the right third is a compact cohort analysis column with a score histogram, assessment completion slope, evidence completeness, MAESTRO result mix, OWASP ASI result mix, and a prominent note "BENCHMARK SCORE V1 — DERIVED".
Style/medium: realistic product UI, not concept art; evidence observatory blended with scientific operations control; crisp, measured, editorial data visualization; flat interface, no perspective device frame.
Composition/framing: full browser viewport at 1440x900; the continuous workflow strip is the first visual read, then the ledger; every comparison value aligned in fixed cells; lower viewport contains a selected-row evidence trace with JSON digest and score components.
Color palette: warm off-white archive paper, deep midnight-indigo structural bands, cobalt blue, saffron amber, oxygen cyan, restrained coral only for blockers; high contrast and accessible.
Typography: bold condensed grotesk for headings and stages, highly readable humanist sans for UI, monospaced numerals only for identifiers and measurements.
Materials/textures: subtle hairline rules and faint printed registration marks; otherwise clean digital surfaces.
Text (verbatim where legible): "ULTRA13 AGENT BENCHMARK", "ASSESSMENT FLOW", "AGENT LEDGER", "3 / 100 ASSESSED", "BENCHMARK SCORE V1 — DERIVED", "UPLOAD ULTRA13 JSON", "UNKNOWN STAYS UNKNOWN".
Constraints: score must visibly appear as a derived benchmark with component breakdown, not as a native Ultra13 score; unknown evidence remains visibly unknown; show no runtime claims; practical controls; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no excessive rounded cards; no decorative illustration; no charts without axes or labels; no logos, trademarks, watermarks, or extra marketing copy.
